canonicalSource: Monad Exchange lifecycle events indexed by Envio
verifier: Perpl dex-sdk at an identical chain, block hash, log cutoff, and timestamp
contextSource: Nansen; optional context cannot alter canonical numbers

accounting.amounts: Finite decimal strings derived from integer native scales
accounting.positionSide: Perpl wire 0=long and 1=short are verified against source payloads and mapped to ledger 1=long and 2=short; other wire values fail closed
accounting.entryPrice: Preserve V2 Q16 residue: long with nonzero residue uses (stored PNS minus one plus residue/65536), short uses (stored PNS plus residue/65536), then apply the native price scale; integer decimal construction rejects inexact representations
accounting.inversion: Verify prior size and collateral; require the resulting side to differ before applying the post-event state
accounting.realizedPnl: Sum of lifecycle delta_pnl_cns; fees and settled funding are reported separately
accounting.unrealizedPnl: Price PnL plus canonically reconstructed unsettled funding; null if any required open-position mark or funding checkpoint is unknown
accounting.freeBalance: Unavailable under risk-hotpath-v2/v3 because subjectless taker balances are excluded
accounting.openInterest: Sum of mark-derived absolute notionals for proven open positions
accounting.tvl: Isolated position collateral only; not total protocol collateral
accounting.volume: Maker fill price times size, counted once
accounting.protocolFees: Insurance plus protocol fees from supported lifecycle transitions
accounting.liquidationPrice: With proven funding F, max(0, entry + sideSign * (maintenance - deposit - F) / size); equity = deposit + price PnL + F and buffer = equity - maintenance. Unknown funding leaves all three null; missing marks leave equity and buffer null
accounting.executableLiquidityRisk: Unavailable until point-in-time order book depth and execution costs are independently captured
accounting.unrealizedPricePnl: Side-adjusted (mark minus effective entry) times size; wallet aggregate is null if any open position lacks an eligible mark
accounting.unrealizedFunding: One ledger applies signed native payment times pre-effective-block size using the scale at publication. Positive payment debits longs and credits shorts. Exact integer decimal construction rejects range or precision loss. Partial decrease/liquidation/deleveraging subtract the actual fundingCNS settlement; increase/inversion/open reset to zero; collateral changes preserve the balance
accounting.maintenanceMargin: Effective entry price times size divided by the registry maintenance inverse; independent of the current mark
accounting.zeroFundingScenario: Conditional equity = deposit + price PnL; buffer = equity - entry-based maintenance; liquidation = max(0, entry + sideSign * (maintenance - deposit) / size). These fields assume zero unsettled funding and are never actual risk facts
accounting.sdkRiskDiagnostics: Verifier only: compare maintenance exactly, price PnL truncated to collateral native units, and liquidation scenarios using SDK reference funding at market price ticks. SDK marks and funding observations never become canonical inputs
accounting.fundingTimeline: Raw signed int48 payments/sums preserve native units, effective block, source ID, overwrite and scaling observations. Published future payments remain pending. Discontinuity and unauthorized replacement fail visibly. This market timeline is separate from each position's checkpoint proof
accounting.fundingCheckpoint: Requires explicit complete market-publication coverage and a reset at or after the first observed effective schedule, which bounds unknown pre-window pending funding under Perpl's single-pending-schedule rule. Earlier resets or absent baselines stay unknown. A later nonzero payment requires a canonical scaling anchor at publication; unknown scale invalidates the amount until another proven reset. Checkpoints retain reset, baseline, payment/scale and settlement event IDs, coverage start and cutoff. Bare replay never infers zero from absent events
accounting.sdkFundedRiskComparison: Verifier only: project price and funding separately to collateral native units before adding total PnL/equity, because the SDK loads deltaPnlCNS and premiumPnlCNS separately. Buffer uses SDK-width canonical entry-based maintenance. Preserve exact canonical values alongside these projections; liquidation is compared at price ticks. Unknown funding scorecards contain zero checks and remain unverified

eligibility.positionReplay: Exact risk-hotpath-v2 or risk-hotpath-v3 provenance and coverage from deployment or account creation; mixed profiles fail
eligibility.cutoff: One immutable event cutoff shared across all selected accounts
eligibility.freshness: Indexer source lag, observation age, and live processed-watermark advancement are checked separately
eligibility.sourceHeightWitness: If the separately polled Envio source height trails committed progress, preserve the original cutoff and seek at most three later source observations 200 ms apart; changed coverage, regression, or failure to cover that cutoff is an error
eligibility.missingData: Explicit null, degraded status, or HTTP 503; never a fabricated zero
eligibility.marks: Positive finite native prices, one mark per market, age strictly below 60000 ms, no future block or timestamp; same-block log cutoffs require matching block hash and log index at or before the cutoff
eligibility.restContext: Sanitized public metadata observation only; composite REST state does not prove mark freshness or an exact log cutoff and never enters canonical accounting
eligibility.registry: Valid contract identities, scales at most 18, consistent exclusions, and maintenance fraction at least the initial fraction, both above 100 hundredths
eligibility.ranges: Block selectors must lie within processed coverage and the selected as-of cutoff
eligibility.canonicalMarketInputs: risk-hotpath-v3: latest MarkUpdated within the shared block/hash/log cutoff and full bounded FundingEventCompleted/scale-update observations inside indexed coverage; v2 never substitutes SDK/REST marks
